python3 -c "
import redis
s=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=0,decode_responses=False)
d=redis.Redis(port=6380,db=0,decode_responses=False)
streams=[x for x in s.scan_iter() if s.type(x)==b'stream']
print('num streams', len(streams))
issues=0
for k in streams:
    se=s.xrange(k,'-','+'); de=d.xrange(k,'-','+')
    if se!=de: print('ENTRIES mismatch',k); issues+=1
    sg=s.xinfo_groups(k); dg=d.xinfo_groups(k)
    if len(sg)!=len(dg): print('GROUP count mismatch',k); issues+=1; continue
    for g1,g2 in zip(sorted(sg,key=lambda x:x['name']),sorted(dg,key=lambda x:x['name'])):
        for f in ['name','last-delivered-id','pending']:
            if g1[f]!=g2[f]: print('GROUP field mismatch',k,f,g1[f],g2[f]); issues+=1
        c1=sorted(s.xinfo_consumers(k,g1['name']),key=lambda x:x['name'])
        c2=sorted(d.xinfo_consumers(k,g2['name']),key=lambda x:x['name'])
        n1=[(c['name'],c['pending']) for c in c1]; n2=[(c['name'],c['pending']) for c in c2]
        if n1!=n2: print('CONSUMER mismatch',k,n1,n2); issues+=1
        p1=sorted((r['message_id'],r['consumer']) for r in s.xpending_range(k,g1['name'],'-','+',100000))
        p2=sorted((r['message_id'],r['consumer']) for r in d.xpending_range(k,g2['name'],'-','+',100000))
        if p1!=p2: print('PEL mismatch',k,p1[:5],p2[:5]); issues+=1
print('issues',issues)
"
